contractGroups.name: dotenv file parsing and application
contractGroups.owner: Complete original node_dotenv.cc; uv_fs_* synchronous operations delegate to real guest libc/VFS; engine embedding owns rooted strings/objects
contractGroups.stateAndErrors: Original map owns copied strings. Existing environment values win. ParsePath uses original Valid/FileError/InvalidContent results; original callers own errno/error selection. Engine conversion failures propagate Maybe emptiness.
contractGroups.schedulingAndLifecycle: Synchronous borrowed Environment and path; original scope guards clean each uv_fs request and close the real descriptor. No invented async handle or queue.
validationRequired: quotes, escapes, comments, multiline and invalid content against pinned native reference
empty, long, unicode and embedded-NUL inputs under original assertions
actual guest open/read/close success/failure and descriptor cleanup
preserve existing values; original NODE_OPTIONS ordering and permission/error behavior
null-prototype ToObject, own data-property attributes, roots across GC and conversion exceptions

contractGroups.name: environment stores
contractGroups.owner: Complete original node_env_var.cc RealEnvStore/MapKVStore; original mutex; libuv uv_os_* and actual guest environ; typed handles/realm scope in engine embedding
contractGroups.stateAndErrors: Original RealEnvStore backs canonical process environment, original MapKVStore owns copies. Missing keys and insufficient getenv capacity retain original behavior. Environment accessor currently selects the original shared process store; worker copy/share selection is not implemented or validated.
contractGroups.schedulingAndLifecycle: Synchronous original mutex and owned strings. Typed LocalVector roots are independent of temporary HandleScopes. Temporary Value-mode buffer roots until array construction. No JS environment proxy created.
contractGroups.timezone: Original POSIX branch calls tzset for TZ mutation; embedding kRedetect calls actual JS::ResetTimeZone. Cross-worker cache invalidation and ICU propagation remain unvalidated.
validationRequired: missing/empty/long/unicode keys and values, inherited environment and mutation coherence
enumeration/pairs order and ownership, clone isolation, SHARE_ENV versus copied worker environments
original AssignFromObject enumerable own names with default numeric-index retention, symbols excluded, getters/conversion errors and proxy errors

normalization, absolute/relative/empty paths and actual cwd errors
